description: Three commands that confirm the tools this tutorial needs: Ollama, the Python requests library, and promptfoo.

steps.description: Each line checks one thing you need. The page lists them as Ollama running with `llama3.2`, Python with `requests` for the code path, and Node.js for the no-code path.
`curl http://localhost:11434/api/tags` talks to Ollama on its local API port, which confirms the server is running and lists the models it has.
`python3 -c "import requests; print('requests ok')"` imports `requests` and prints `requests ok`, which confirms the code path's library is installed.
`npx promptfoo@latest --version` runs promptfoo through `npx`, so there is nothing else to install for the no-code path.
